        class AAImage extends AAObject implements Serializable
        serialVersionUID:
        -7826688565768235972L

        • Serialized Fields

          • imageFileURL
            String imageFileURL
            URL of the file that contains the image to be displayed in the area display. If the URL is for a file on the local file system, be sure to use an absolute path to the file. The file will be loaded from the "working" directory of the TaskMaster, so use of a relative path to the image file is likely to fail to locate it properly.
          • resizeHeight
            Integer resizeHeight
            Height (pixels) to resize the image to for the display. Null or zero for no resize
          • resizeWidth
            Integer resizeWidth
            Width (pixels) to resize the image to for the display. Null or zero for no resize
          • rotateDegrees
            Integer rotateDegrees
            Degrees (clockwise) to rotate the image to for the display. Null or zero for no resize
          • xyPosition
            XY xyPosition
            X,Y position in the display of the center of the image
          • zOrder
            Integer zOrder
            Order of the image in the layers of objects in the area display. Lower number is closer to viewer.

    • Package sysmlinjava.views.barcharts

      • Class sysmlinjava.views.barcharts.BarChartData

        class BarChartData extends Object implements Serializable
        serialVersionUID:
        8005702743864254971L

        • Serialized Fields

          • barChartID
            String barChartID
            ID of the bar chart on which the data is to be displayed
          • catYData
            ArrayList<ArrayList<CatYData>> catYData
            Data for the bar chart, i.e. a list of lists of category (bar) values, where the inner list is list of the values represented at one layer in the "stack" of values in a stacked bar. The outer list is a list of these lists of values for one layer. For a single value bar chart, i.e. no "stacked" bars, the outter list will contain only a single list of CatYData objects. For a two value stack bar chart, the outter list will contain two lists of CayYData objects, etc.

      • Class sysmlinjava.views.barcharts.BarChartDefinition

        class BarChartDefinition extends Object implements Serializable
        serialVersionUID:
        8945635974734237468L

        • Serialized Fields

          • barChartID
            String barChartID
            ID of the chart (used to associate data received with the chart)
          • catAxis
            CategoriesAxis catAxis
            Category (bar) axis
          • layerNames
            ArrayList<String> layerNames
            List of the names of the layers of the "stacked" bar chart. If there are multiple layers of values for each of the bars in the bar chart, i.e. the chart is a stacked bar chart, then these names will be used for the legend of layer names. The index of the name string in the list will be used as the index into the BarChartData's catYData list to which the name will be applied, i.e. the first name in this list will be applied to the first/bottom-most layer of each of the bars; the second name in this list will be applied to the second from the bottom layer of each of the bars; and so on.
          • yAxis
            Axis yAxis
            Y (bar value) axis

      • Class sysmlinjava.views.common.GeospatialCoordinateTransform

        class GeospatialCoordinateTransform extends Object implements Serializable
        serialVersionUID:
        823646528010005640L

        • Serialized Fields

          • geospatialUpperLeft
            PointGeospatial geospatialUpperLeft
            Geospatial point that corresponds to the upper left corner of the geospatial area display. This parameter, along with pointsPerRadianLatitude and pointsPerRadianLongitude below, is used to translate all geospatial points (lats/lons) to cartesian points (X/Y) in the area display.
          • kilometerPerRadianLon
            RReal kilometerPerRadianLon
            Value for converting radians of longitude (for a specified latitude) to kilometers
          • pointsCartesianPerKilometer
            RReal pointsCartesianPerKilometer
            Value for converting kilometers into cartesian points (x or y) for the current area display
          • pointsPerRadianLatitude
            RReal pointsPerRadianLatitude
            Value of the number of X,Y points (XYDatas) in a radian of latitude. This parameter, along with geospatialUpperLeft is used to translate all geospatial points (lats/lons) to cartesian points (X/Y) in the area display.
          • pointsPerRadianLongitude
            RReal pointsPerRadianLongitude
            Value of the number of X,Y points (XYDatas) in a radian of longitude. Note this is a derived value and, along with geospatialUpperLeft is used to translate all geospatial points (lats/lons) to cartesian points (X/Y) in the area display.

    • Package sysmlinjava.views.linechart

      • Class sysmlinjava.views.linechart.LineChartData

        class LineChartData extends Object implements Serializable
        serialVersionUID:
        -7567118199087274202L

        • Serialized Fields

          • chartID
            String chartID
            ID of the line chart on which the data is to be displayed
          • linesPoints
            List<List<Point2D>> linesPoints
            Point data for the lines in the line chart. The outtermost list is a list of the lists of points to be added to each line in the line chart display. The first list of points is for the first line which uses the rightmost y-axis in the chart. The 2nd list of points is for the 2nd line which uses the 2nd from the right y-axis in the chart, etc. The list can be described as follows:
            • if y-axes count >= 0, 1st list element is list of points, if any, to be added to 1st line associated with 1st y-axis from right
            • if y-axes count >= 1, 2nd list element is list of points, if any, to be added to 2nd line associated with 2nd y-axis from right
            • if y-axes count >= 2, 3rd list element is list of points, if any, to be added to 3rd line associated with 3rd y-axis from right
            • if y-axes count >= 3, 4th list element is list of points, if any, to be added to 4th line associated with 4th y-axis from right
